data.one_liner: A Flutter sticky headers and index ListView with an IndexBar.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sticky headers and index ListView along with an IndexBar widget. It supports features like A-Z grouping, floating sticky headers, custom headers, index linkage, and custom IndexBar styles.
use_when: Building contact list or city list interfaces with alphabetical indexes.
Implementing sticky headers with floating options in a list view.
avoid_when: Needing general-purpose list views without index sidebars or sticky headers.
strengths: Easy creation of city lists or contact lists.
Supports custom headers and IndexBar styles.
Allows scrolling to a specific item in the list.
weaknesses: Relies on a specific external dependency (scrollable_positioned_list).
Limited to list views with alphabetical or indexed grouping.
